Is it true one man survived BOTH atomic bombs?
Yamaguchi, a young engineer, was in Hiroshima on a business trip.
The blast burst his eardrums and burned the left side of his body.
He spent the night in a bomb shelter.
Three days later, bandaged, he went back to work.
He was telling his boss that one bomb had destroyed a whole city.
His boss said he was crazy.
What happened to him after that?
He lived to be 93, and spent his later years warning the world about nuclear weapons.
In 2009, Japan officially recognized him as the only person to survive both bombings.
